error_codes.meaning: Indoor coil fault and sensor fault

warnings: DUE TO HIGH VOLTAGE, DO NOT TOUCH THE TERMINALS IN THE CONTROL BOARD DURING OPERATION AND 5 MINUTES AFTER SWITCHING OFF. NEXT, CONFIRM THE VOLTAGE RECTIFICATION CIRCUIT BETWEEN DIODE BRIDGE (+) AND (-) HAS DROPPED TO BELOW 42V, BEFORE ACCESSING THE TERMINALS IN THE CONTROL BOARD.

steps.instruction: Check to make sure that the voltage between (+) and (–) of the power module is approx. 0 V before checking.
steps.summary_en: Check to make sure that the voltage between (+) and (–) of the power module is approx. 0 V before checking.

steps.instruction: Discharge the capacitor completely before conducting repair work.
